subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should the remaining work be split so the `heartbeat.session` precedence bug lands first while Telegram DM default isolation remains a separate compatibility decision?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence path is a source-provable bug, but changing Telegram DMs away from documented main-session sharing would alter established behavior for existing users.

options.title: Split heartbeat fix first
options.body: Adopt or replace a narrow heartbeat wake/session repair so configured heartbeat sessions win, while leaving default DM isolation controlled by `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

options.title: Bundle Telegram isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default in the same work, accepting docs, tests, and upgrade impact for users relying on main-session continuity.

options.title: Defer to heartbeat entries
options.body: Hold the bug for the broader native per-session heartbeat scheduling design, which may be cleaner long term but leaves the current forced-session path unresolved.

recommendation.title: Split heartbeat fix first
recommendation.body: Adopt or replace a narrow heartbeat wake/session repair so configured heartbeat sessions win, while leaving default DM isolation controlled by `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice crosses the Telegram DM routing/product boundary that PR #40519 explicitly scoped away from, while the heartbeat fix can be reviewed against that boundary.
